{{Quote|When you reach open sea, head for the Europa Islands, where you'll rendezvous with a resistance freighter.|Rhys Dallows|<ref name="SWS" />}}
The '''Europa Islands''' was an archipelago located off the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]] delta on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the islands [[Raid on the Solleu River|served as a rendezvous point]] between [[Rescue Flight]] and the Naboo [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Mercatan]]''.<ref name="SWS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Europa Islands appear in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']].<ref name="SWS" />
